configuration.title: Kratos MDPA Preview
config.kratos.showWhatsNew.markdownDescr: Show the **What's New** screen after the extension is updated, summarizing the changelog entries newer than the version you last saw. Reopen it anytime with the **Kratos MDPA: Show What's New** command.
config.kratos.pythonPath.markdownDescrip: Python executable used to run cases (`python MainKratos.py`). Leave empty to use `python3` (`python` on Windows). Point it at the interpreter where Kratos is pip-installed, or at any python when `#kratos.installPath#` is set.
config.kratos.installPath.markdownDescri: Root of a **compiled** Kratos install (the directory containing `KratosMultiphysics/` and `libs/`) — a Kratos **source checkout** also works, its `bin/Release`/`bin/Debug` build output is auto-detected. Added to `PYTHONPATH` and the platform's shared-library path when running a case. Set it via the **Kratos Case: Select Kratos Installation Folder…** command, or leave empty for a pip-installed Kratos (`pip install KratosMultiphysics-all`).
config.kratos.extraEnv.markdownDescripti: Extra environment variables for the run terminal, e.g. `{"OMP_NUM_THREADS": "4"}`. Set verbatim (overrides computed values).
config.kratos.problemtypes.extraPaths.ma: Directories scanned for user problemtype definitions (`*.js` / `*.py`), relative to each workspace folder (absolute paths allowed).
config.kratos.materials.extraPaths.markd: Directories scanned for **material presets** (`*.json`), relative to each workspace folder (absolute paths allowed). Each file holds one preset, or `{"version": 1, "presets": [ … ]}`; a row needs an `id`, a `name`, the `laws` it fits, its `values` with their `units`, and a `source`. The Problemtype sidebar's Materials form lists them beside the rows shipped with the extension, and every case keeps a snapshot of the values it was given — so editing a file here never rewrites a case that already used it.
config.kratos.recipes.extraPaths.markdow: Directories scanned for **batch recipe presets** (`*.json`), relative to each workspace folder (absolute paths allowed). Each file holds a named op list plus optional batch defaults (`naming`, `outputExt`, `overwrite`); the batch command and `mesh_batch_transform` resolve presets by name against these directories.
config.kratos.flowgraph.splitOrientation: Default split direction when the **Flowgraph** problemtype is selected: `horizontal` puts the embedded [Flowgraph](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kratos-flowgraph/flowgraph) node editor below the mesh view, `vertical` puts it beside. Toggleable live from the pane.
Flowgraph opens in a pane below the 3D view.
Flowgraph opens in a pane beside the 3D view.
config.kratos.flowgraph.assetPathOverrid: Advanced/dev only: absolute path to a local `@kratos-flowgraph/flowgraph` checkout (the folder containing `public/` and `views/`) to serve instead of the bundled copy under `dist/flowgraph/`. Leave empty to use the bundled assets.
config.kratos.preview.autoSave.markdownD: Let VS Code's `#files.autoSave#` write mesh previews back to disk. Off by default: saving a preview re-serialises the whole mesh over the source file and can drop comments and formatting, and the one-time overwrite warning is not shown again once accepted — so with auto-save enabled every edit would silently rewrite the file you opened. When this is off, an automatic save is refused and the tab simply stays marked as unsaved; `Ctrl+S` and **File ▸ Save** still work.
config.kratos.export.provenance.markdown: Where an export records its provenance. The Export Report panel shows retained/transformed/omitted/unverified data regardless of this setting. Native MDPA, VTK XML (including VTM children), OBJ and PLY embed safe comments; legacy VTK uses a 255-byte title and warns on truncation. STL and temporal XDMF have no embedding slot: use `sidecar` for their complete record. Series share one collection sidecar; Save problem embeds a separate record without rewriting source mesh bytes.
config.kratos.export.provenance.enumDesc: Embed provenance in supported native comments/headers or meshio++ slots; problem archives embed a separate provenance record.
Also write `<output>.kratosexport.json` holding the full report (one roll-up per series); problem archives embed their record inside the ZIP.
Add no new provenance or sidecar. Reports still appear in replies and batch/split manifests; copied source bytes keep existing provenance.
config.kratos.preview.summaryThresholdMb: Show a **header summary** instead of loading a mesh larger than this many megabytes — counts, entity blocks and data-array names, with an **Open full mesh anyway** button in the preview. Set to `0` to always load the full mesh. How much of the file a summary actually reads depends on the format, and the preview says which it did: VTK XML, PLY, binary STL and `.vtm` need only the header; `.mdpa`, `.obj` and ASCII STL are streamed once without building a mesh (`.mdpa` declares no counts anywhere, so there is no header to read); the meshio++ formats (`.msh`, `.xdmf`, `.inp`, `.e`, …) are read whole, because their readers are.
config.kratos.plots.persistentCache.mark: Keep a bounded on-disk cache (256 MiB, 512 entries) of disk-backed Plots extractions — mesh tables, probe profiles, regional quantities and histories — under the extension's global storage, so reopening a plot after a restart does not reread the files. An entry is reused only while the source, its companion files and its timeline have exactly the content it was built from; any change, addition or missing file is a miss. Live-mesh snapshots and fixed profile-following snapshots are never cached on disk. Off by default.
config.kratos.preview.renderer.markdownD: Rendering backend for mesh previews. **VTK-wasm is experimental**: it is VTK's own renderer compiled to WebAssembly, shipped with the extension (no download at runtime), and an opt-in alternative to vtk.js, which remains the default. The setting applies to previews opened after it changes; if VTK-wasm cannot start, the preview falls back to vtk.js and says why.
config.kratos.preview.renderer.enumDescr: VTK-wasm (experimental) — VTK's own C++ renderer compiled to WebAssembly. Needs WebAssembly JSPI (VS Code 1.138+ desktop and recent Chromium have it); falls back to vtk.js with a message when it cannot start.
config.kratos.run.launchMode.markdownDes: How `Run case` launches the solver. `output` is tracked; `terminal` is interactive but untracked.
config.kratos.run.launchMode.enumDescrip: Run the solver as a tracked child process, with its output in an Output channel. Gives a real exit code, live progress and a working Stop.
Run in an integrated terminal, as before. Interactive (prompts, conda activate), but a terminal cannot report when the solver exits, so the run is listed as "detached" and its status is not tracked.
config.kratos.run.stopOnWindowClose.mark: Stop running solvers when the window closes or reloads. Turn this off to let a solve continue in the background — it is then detached, and the extension can no longer report its exit code.
